nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) holding holder balances in the LIGHTINGNETWORK token; written without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of owner to spender allowances; decremented with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Total token supply, set once in the constructor from _supply scaled by decimals.
Private owner address assigned to msg.sender in the constructor; sole authority for delegate and batchSend.
Token name string set in the constructor.
Token symbol string set in the constructor.
Constant internal UNI router address 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D granted unlimited allowance in the constructor.
Private mapping(address=>uint) of internal ERC20 balances mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
Private nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of internal ERC20 allowances mutated by _approve and read by transferFrom.
Private internal ERC20 total supply mutated by _mint and _burn.
Public payable transfer(address,uint) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked allowance and balance subtractions when msg.sender != _from.
Public payable approve(address,uint) that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zeroing first.
Owner-only public delegate(address,bytes) performing an arbitrary delegatecall into an attacker-supplied address and payload.
Owner-only payable batchSend(address[],uint) with unchecked multiplication of _value by _tos.length and double Transfer emission of _value/2.
Modifier ensure(address,address) that recomputes a Uniswap pair via pairFor and requires _from or _to to be owner or the derived pair.
Internal pure pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) computing a CREATE2 Uniswap pair address via keccak256 of the init code hash.
Payable constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and granting uint(-1) allowance to the UNI router.
Internal ERC20 _transfer(address,address,uint) using SafeMath sub/add on _balances with zero-address requires.
Public ERC20 transferFrom(address,address,uint) calling _transfer and decrementing allowance via SafeMath sub.
Internal ERC20 _approve(address,address,uint) writing _allowances with zero-address requires.
Internal ERC20 _mint(address,uint) increasing _totalSupply and _balances with SafeMath add.
Internal ERC20 _burn(address,uint) decreasing _balances and _totalSupply with SafeMath sub.
Private SafeERC20 helper executing a raw low-level token.call(data) and optionally decoding a bool result.
Internal SafeERC20 safeTransfer(IERC20,address,uint) encoding transfer and delegating to callOptionalReturn.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance keys, balance debits and owner initialization.
Arbitrary delegatecall to address a with bytes b inside delegate(), granting full storage and selfdestruct control to the owner.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length in batchSend that can overflow in Solidity 0.5 without SafeMath.
Unchecked subtractions allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value and balanceOf[_from] -= _value in transferFrom.
Raw address(token).call(data) low-level external call in callOptionalReturn that can re-enter the calling context.
Recipient parameter forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
Amount parameter forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
Source account parameter used for balance and allowance lookups in transferFrom.
Destination account parameter credited in transferFrom.
Amount parameter subtracted unchecked from allowance and balance in transferFrom.
Spender key written into the allowance mapping by approve.
Allowance amount written by approve.
Attacker/owner-supplied target address for the delegatecall.
Caller-supplied calldata executed via delegatecall.
Recipient array iterated in batchSend and used for the unchecked length multiplication.
Per-recipient amount multiplied by _tos.length in batchSend.
Constructor argument assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor argument assigned to the symbol state variable.
Constructor argument scaled by 10**decimals to set totalSupply.
Local total computed as _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
Loop counter in batchSend.
Loop-local recipient extracted from _tos[i] in batchSend.
Local pair address computed by pairFor and compared against _from in the ensure modifier.
Local CREATE2 pair address derived from factory, sorted tokens and init code hash.
